module purpose: neorv32_cpu_alu computes comparison, arithmetic and logical ALU results from rs1_i/rs2_i and control inputs, selects the main result for res_o, and exposes a dedicated add/sub result on add_o. It also integrates optional co-processor sub-units, reports their completion on done_o, returns FPU/CFU CSR read data on csr_o, and keeps CFU activity state for multi-cycle custom operations.

use-case flows.value: two-bit equality/less-than comparison result from rs1_i and rs2_i with signed/unsigned control
selected operands added or subtracted, with the arithmetic result driven on add_o and reused by the main ALU result path
main ALU result selected onto res_o from zero, add, co-processor, set-less-than, move, xor, or and and cases
FPU and CFU CSR access qualification, including address decode and CSR write-enable generation toward the sub-units
FPU or CFU CSR read data gated by CSR address decode and returned on csr_o
custom-function-unit request tracking, including busy/active state and qualified result capture
co-processor completion indication when any co-processor valid signal is asserted
CFU busy state and the registered CFU result lane cleared when rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.concept: Comparison outcome used by the ALU and optional co-processors
conceptual assets.reasoning: The compare flow builds signed or unsigned operands at lines 97-98, computes equality at line 100 and less-than at line 101, copies the two-bit result to cmp_o at line 102, and also delivers cmp to the bitmanip and FPU sub-units at lines 230 and 263. Integrity is established because cmp_o and those sub-unit consumers must receive exactly the comparison decisions defined by these statements; availability is also established because the result is driven combinationally whenever the inputs are present.

The arithmetic flow selects opa and opb at lines 107-108, sign-extends them under alu_unsigned at lines 113-114, computes subtraction or addition in addsub_res at lines 116-117, drives add_o at line 119, and reuses the result for res_o in the add and set-less-than cases at lines 129 and 131. Integrity is established because downstream logic must receive exactly the arithmetic result defined by these operations; availability is established because add_o is continuously driven from addsub_res.

conceptual assets.concept: Main ALU execution result returned on res_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: The alu_core process initializes res_o at line 126 and then, under the ctrl_i.alu_op case at lines 127-136, selects zero, addsub_res, cp_res, the sign bit for SLT, opb, xor, or, or and results. cp_res itself is formed from cp_result at line 151 for the co-processor case. Integrity is established because the consumer of res_o must receive exactly the case-selected value defined by these RTL branches; availability is established because res_o is always assigned in the process.

The report flow defines done_o as the OR of all cp_valid lanes at line 147. Those lanes are produced by the shifter, mul/div, bitmanip, FPU, CFU, conditional and crypto paths at lines 177, 200, 236, 269, 343, 373 and 407, with disabled extensions tied low in their false generate branches. Integrity is established because external consumers must see completion exactly when any valid source is asserted; availability is conditional on the corresponding enabled co-processor path producing valid_o.

conceptual assets.concept: FPU/CFU CSR read data returned by the ALU
conceptual assets.reasoning: When the FPU path is generated, line 275 forwards fpu_csr_rd to csr_rdata_fpu only when the address decode at line 273 enables it; when the CFU path is generated, line 320 forwards cfu_csr_rd to csr_rdata_cfu only when the address decode at line 318 enables it. csr_o returns the OR of these gated read-data signals at line 155. Integrity is established because the consumer of csr_o must receive exactly the selected sub-unit CSR data defined by the decode and gating logic; availability is established under the RTL-visible conditions that the corresponding generate block exists and the address matches.

This module decodes ctrl_i.csr_addr against the FPU flags CSR and the CFU CSR region at lines 273 and 318, and combines those enables with ctrl_i.csr_we at lines 274 and 319 to generate fpu_csr_we and cfu_csr_we, which are delivered to the FPU and CFU sub-units at lines 258 and 301. Integrity is established because those sub-unit consumers must receive exactly the write-enable decisions defined by the address-decode and csr_we logic; availability is conditional on the corresponding generate block being enabled and the decode matching.

Within the CFU generate block, cfu_busy is reset to '0' at line 326, cleared on cfu_done or ctrl_i.cpu_trap at lines 329-330, and set when ctrl_i.alu_cp_cfu is asserted at lines 331-332. This stored state then drives cfu_active at line 342 and qualifies CFU result capture and validity at lines 334-343. Integrity is established because these start, hold and clear conditions define whether a CFU operation remains active across cycles; availability is established because the state is explicitly preserved by the clocked process until done, trap or reset.
